entries.error: Perkins published a manuscript on the history of the Santa Clarita Valley in 1957. In 1962 he wrote a series of articles for The Signal newspaper, appropriately titled "Story of our Valley."
entries.correction: In 1957 the HSSC Quarterly published his 'Rancho San Francisco: A Study of a California Land Grant' (June 1957). 'The Story of Our Valley' ran in The Signal in 1954–55 (an earlier version ran in 1946–47).
entries.source: perkins intro (Apr 1954–Jan 1955; intro says Perkins began ~1930, had his answers '20 years previously', and this 'new, revised, augmented' version runs 'down to the year 1950'); lat19770102perkins (Apr 1–Dec 30, 1954); the page's own sidebar ('Story of Our Valley 1954-55'); general.htm ('1954-55'); sg19470102perkins (1946/47 version); outside: elsmerecanyon.com sources list cites Signal issues Sept 2–Oct 7, 1954 for the series and 'The Pico Ghost Camp' Jan 18 & 25, 1962 (likely source of the '1962' confusion). No 1962 run/reprint/booklet found; an unrecorded 1962 re-run is NEEDS_VERIFICATION (Newhall Signal 1962 run).
